root_cause.text: In `xe_dma_buf_init_obj()`, when `drm_gpuvm_resv_object_alloc()` fails, the pre-allocated `storage` BO is not freed, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `xe_bo_free(storage)` inside the `if (!dummy_obj)` block, and the commit message explicitly states: "When drm_gpuvm_resv_object_alloc() fails, the pre-allocated storage bo is not freed. Add xe_bo_free(storage) before returning the error."

intent_record.intent_summary: Add comment clarifying ownership transfer semantics of xe_dma_buf_init_obj.
intent_record.what: Added a multi-line comment before the `xe_dma_buf_init_obj` function explaining that it takes ownership of `storage`, transfers it to the returned object on success or frees it on failure, and that callers must not free `storage` after this call.
intent_record.how: No change to program behavior; only documentation is added.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leak by freeing storage bo on dummy object allocation failure.
intent_record.what: Added a call to xe_bo_free(storage) inside the error handling block when drm_gpuvm_resv_object_alloc returns NULL, before returning ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM).
intent_record.how: Prevents a memory leak by freeing the storage buffer object when allocation of the dummy object fails, ensuring proper cleanup on the error path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Added clarifying comment about memory cleanup behavior of xe_bo_init_locked.
intent_record.what: Added a comment line /* xe_bo_init_locked() frees storage on error */ before the call to xe_bo_init_locked in xe_dma_buf_init_obj.
intent_record.how: No functional change; the comment serves as documentation for developers to understand that xe_bo_init_locked will free the storage parameter if an error occurs.

bic_trace_step.reason: In `xe_dma_buf_init_obj()`, on error from `__xe_bo_create_locked()`, the function returns ERR_PTR(ret) without freeing the pre-allocated `storage` parameter. In the caller `xe_gem_prime_import()`, after `xe_dma_buf_init_obj()` returns an error, the code returns the error pointer without freeing the pre-allocated `bo` (which is the `storage`). This causes a memory leak of the `bo` allocated by `xe_bo_alloc()`. No fix is present; the leak exists.
